questions.question: What does David ask the LORD to do in Psalm 35?
options: Bless those who curse his name
Forgive each one of those who have wronged him
Ignore those who plot against him
Contend with those who contend with him
questions.answer: Contend with those who contend with him

questions.question: How did David treat his enemies when they were sick?
options: He brought charges against them in court
He wore sackcloth and prayed for them
He fled far away from their presence
He repaid them with kindness and gifts
questions.answer: He wore sackcloth and prayed for them

questions.question: David asks God to take hold of shield and buckler and rise for his help.
Say to my soul, 'I am your _____.'
My tongue shall tell of your righteousness and of your praise all the _____ long.
